en: public; common; shared; open to all
issue: gloss 'communal' is misleading: in Indian English communal means sectarian/religious-conflict-related (that is सांप्रदायिक), the opposite of the neutral 'public' sense
IPA: schwa deletion not applied (spoken karmchari, not karma-chari) — same spurious schwa in the lemma entry कर्मचारी (kərmətʃaːriː)

en: get down to (a task); set about; be engaged in; gather, assemble (of a crowd) (stem form, used before an auxiliary)
issue: gloss reductive: misses the core intransitive sense of जुटना 'to gather/assemble' (as in a crowd gathering)
